en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside scene. On the left stands a large historic building with a tower and steep roof, resembling a small castle or manor, surrounded by dense trees on a rocky bank. In the foreground is a calm river or lake with reeds along the shore. Across the water on the right is a long low bridge or weir structure and small buildings with red roofs, all set against a tree-lined horizon under a pastel sky. Red printed text at the top reads the location and subject in German.
